headline: GK Energy posts Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs 4,02.65 crore with 18.5% EBITDA margin
hook: Steady growth reported in second quarter
summary: GK Energy Limited reported its Q2 FY27 financial results, posting a revenue from operations of Rs 4,026.54 million and an EBITDA of Rs 744.15 million. The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 18.5% for the quarter. Additionally, the company recorded 19,391 systems installed during the period. Retail investors can track these operational metrics to gauge the company's execution capabilities in the renewable energy sector.

headline: GK Energy bags Rs 330.29 crore solar pumping systems contract from MSEDCL
hook: Major solar order boosts order book
summary: GK Energy has secured a Rs. 330.29 crore contract from the Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company (MSEDCL) to supply and install solar water pumping systems. This sizeable project reinforces the company's order pipeline in the renewable energy sector. Indian retail investors tracking green energy stocks can gauge execution capabilities from such institutional wins.
